stemMd: Choose the best transition: "The new archive catalog is easy to search. ___, several handwritten entries still need to be transcribed before the catalog is complete."
explanationMd: The second sentence limits the positive assessment in the first. A contrast transition introduces the remaining work without suggesting an unsupported cause.

distractorRationale.d: The unfinished work qualifies the positive claim rather than exemplifying searchability.
distractorRationale.a: Ease of searching does not cause entries to remain untranscribed.
distractorRationale.c: The second sentence presents a limitation, not a parallel benefit.
